messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering-token-drift detected in prod-eu1. Symptom: token counts skew vs shadow by ~4-12% starting 2026-03-20T02:07Z. Alerts: overage_flags for ~0.6% of accounts. Severity: P2 	6 customer-visible flags. Link: https://internal/reports/1719802468
ash (oncall): ack. I'm on it. @maria @sara please standby. :eyes:
maria (billing-eng): looking. Initial query shows emitter counts OK, but aggregator delta windows are misaligned. Pulling last 6 hours. Can someone hold on notifying customers?
sara (support): pausing auto-notify for impacted accounts now (mute rule applied). I'll double-check any open tickets.
ops-sre: seeing elevated lag on metering-collector-kafka consumer group in eu1. Offset backlog ~4k messages. Could explain delayed reports.
andy (eng): ping 	6 did we roll anything to metering-agg in the last 12h? I don't see a deployment, but there was a config flip on windowing TTL at 00:30Z.
maria (billing-eng): show query:
```
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM metering.aggregates
WHERE env='prod-eu1' AND window_start >= now()-interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 12;
```
results show repeating -1 windows at 02:04-02:10Z -> possible window key collision.
ash (oncall): ops-sre, can you stabilize consumers? If backlog drains, do we expect counts to reconcile or will drift remain?
ops-sre: if we drain and replay, raw emit counts match shadow, but aggregator dedupe/windowing is likely the source of drift. Replays will reduce delayed reports but won't fix already-triggered overage flags.
maria (billing-eng): mitigation plan: 1) disable automated overage flagging for the next 30m, 2) route new aggregates through alternate worker (non-ttl config), 3) run reconciliation job for affected windows.
ash (oncall): step 1 done 	6 overage notifications paused (mute applied at 1719802500). Notified CS.
sara (support): confirmed. Customer notify suppressed; I'll prepare a templated outbound if we need to contact enterprise customers (short note, ETA for resolution ~1h).
andy (eng): spinning up alternate worker pool with earlier windowing config now. ETA ~6 minutes.
ops-sre: replay started from kafka offsets 153210 -> 157000. Monitoring consumer lag and reconciliation throughput.
maria (billing-eng): running a dry-run of reconciliation. Preliminary diff: ~0.9% of tokens re-attributed to later windows. We'll need to run final reconcile once replay completes.
customers-team-bot: Note: Two customers (acct_394, acct_892) already filed billing tickets referencing overage emails at 02:12Z.
sara (support): escalating acct_394 to enterprise CS lead; sending holding message now: "We've paused notifications and are investigating a metering reconciliation. No charges will be applied while we review." :white_check_mark:
nash (oncall): timeline check 	6 root detection 1719802468. Current last_message_ts 1719804800. Keep this thread for live updates. If anything changes, call page to P1.
maria (billing-eng): replay finished. Alternate workers processed backlog. Reconciliation diff job queued; estimate 12-18 minutes to finish.
ops-sre: consumer lag is stable now, throughput consistent at 1200 msg/s. No new drift observed for last 4 windows.
maria (billing-eng): reconcile finished. Summary: global token delta reconciled to <0.3% vs shadow; affected accounts flagged earlier will have flags rescinded. Will run final correction into billing ledger at 03:15Z.
sara (support): sent update to impacted customers with ETA and temporary credit pledge for any incorrect overage. CS will follow up 1:1 for enterprise.
nash (oncall): closing live mitigation. Postmortem owner: @maria. Severity P2 -> postmortem + runbook update (windowing TTL flip must be gated). I'll mark incident resolved and create follow-up tasks.
incident-bot: Incident resolved. Tags: metering, billing, kafka, reconciliation. Incident duration: ~68 minutes. Link: https://internal/incidents/1719802468
